## Workload

Priya Anand completed the grading workload recorded for the review period, with 189 reads across 354 hours. This represents a recorded rate of 0.5 per hour. The workload was reviewed against the available grading information to support a clear assessment of activity and consistency. The figures provide the basis for considering both the volume of work completed and the time allocated to it. They also allow the review to distinguish between overall throughput and the quality checks undertaken during the period.

## Quality

A total of 17 items were checked again as part of the quality review. Agreement was recorded at 76.5. The checked items included borderline background cases, where additional consideration was appropriate. The review identified the level of agreement across the sample and provided feedback on those cases requiring closer attention. Priya Anand was both the grader and the reviewer, ensuring that the workload and quality findings were considered together in the review record.
